blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A large language model (LLM) can turn a text into a distribution over an ordered scale, but that distribution is a noisy measurement: saturated, compressed or exaggerated, and biased in a consistent direction. We propose CORDIAL, which treats the model’s output as a noisy reading of the true label and corrects it with a channel of five interpretable parameters. The channel is small enough for its posterior to be averaged from a handful of labels, and we prove that the resulting calibration preserves first-order stochastic order. On Amazon reviews and CMU-MOSEI transcripts with four LLMs, CORDIAL has the lowest log loss among nine calibrators in 76 of 80 settings with 5 to 100 labels; with 20 labels and the main 7B reader, it matches the strongest baseline using 28–54 labels. The same posterior lets us learn priors from other tasks and fuse several LLMs. Unrestricted calibrators such as Dirichlet calibration overtake it only as the calibration set grows into the hundreds or thousands.
blocks.zh: 一个大语言模型(LLM)可以将一个文本在有序的尺度上变成分布,但这种分布是一种吵闹的测量:饱和,压缩或夸大,偏重一致的方向. 我们提出CORDIAL, 将模型的输出视为对真实标签的噪音读取, 这个信道很小,可以从少数标签中平均得出它的后遗症,我们证明由此而来的校准能保持第一阶的调序. 在亚马逊评论和带有四个LLMs的CMU-MOSEI记录誊本上,CORDIAL在80个设置中的76个有5到100个标签的9个计算器中的日志损失最低;拥有20个标签和主要的7B阅读器,它与使用28–54个标签的最强基线匹配. 同样的后期让我们从其他任务中吸取前科,并融合了几个有限责任公司。 诸如Dirichlet校准等不受限制的校准器只在校准器组成长成数百或数千个时才超过它.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A large language model (LLM) can read a review or a spoken sentence and return a distribution over an ordered scale [ 1 ] . Such outputs are useful measurements but not calibrated statistics: a model may understand every sentence and still rate one star too generously [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] , spread its mass too widely or too narrowly [ 5 ] , or deserve less trust than its confidence suggests, since post-training degrades calibration [ 6 , 7 ] . Treating the output as a noisy measurement of the true label turns calibration into channel estimation from very few labels, which an LLM is deployed to avoid collecting.
blocks.zh: 一个大语言模型(LLM)可以读取评论或口语句子,并返回一个按顺序比例[1]的分布. 这种产出是有用的测量,但没有校准统计:一个模型可能理解每个句子,仍然对一颗恒星的评分过于慷慨[2,3,4],其质量分布过于广泛或过于狭窄[5],或值得信任的程度低于其信任度,因为训练后会降低校准[6,7]。 将输出作为真实标签的吵闹度量,将校准转化为从极少数标签的通道估计,为此部署了LLM以避免收集.

blocks.en: The usual answer is a scalar, a temperature or a reliability weight toward a population prior; we show that a scalar reliability cannot move mass to a neighboring class and so cannot correct a directional error. An unrestricted K × K K\times K matrix or Dirichlet calibration can, but spends K ⁡ ( K − 1 ) K(K-1) or K ⁡ ( K + 1 ) K(K+1) parameters on the few labels available. We propose CORDIAL ( C alibrating ordi n al outputs), a structured semantic channel whose five parameters, temperature, offset, gain, concentration, and strength, match the geometry of ordinal errors, in a mixture form that keeps the shape of the reading and a unimodal location form. With five parameters the posterior can be averaged over, which hedges against the estimation error that dominates with a few dozen labels, and the channels are stacked with logit-space calibrators.
blocks.zh: 通常的答案是先对人群的分级、温度或可靠性加权;我们表明,分级可靠性不能移动质量到邻类,因此不能纠正方向错误。 一个不受限制的K × K K\times K矩阵或 Drichlet 校准可以,但将 K → (K− 1) K(K-1) 或 K → (K+ 1) K(K+1) 参数花费在少数可用的标签上. 我们建议使用C arbrating ordi n al 输出,这是一个结构化的语义通道,其五个参数,温度,抵消,增益,集中和强度,与正数误差的几何相匹配,其混合形式保持读数的形状和单模式位置形式. 有了五个参数后,可以进行平均,这个参数与以几十个标签占据主导地位的估计误差相对立,通道上堆放着对数空间计数器.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: (C1) the Bayesian structured channel in two forms, a proof that it never reverses the ordinal order of readings, and its stacking with logit-space calibrators; (C2) a parameter-counting crossover, n ⋆ = ( d u − d s ) / ( 2 ​ δ ) n^{\star}=(d_{\rm u}-d_{\rm s})/(2\delta) for a measurable gap δ \delta , that predicts the scale at which unrestricted calibrators take over; and (C3) three uses of the five-parameter posterior, a prior learned across tasks, few-label fusion of several frozen LLMs, and a one-parameter per-user shift, with evidence on Amazon Reviews 2023 and CMU-MOSEI transcripts with four readers.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:(C1) 巴伊西亚结构化通道有两种形式,证明它从未逆转读数的正数顺序,并用对数空间计算器堆叠;(C2)参数的交叉,n = = (du-d s) / (2 ) n = star = (d_{\rm u}-d_{\rm s})/(2\delta),用于一个可测量的缺口,预测无限制的计算器接管的比例;和(C3) 五参数后置器的三种用途,一种是先前学到的跨任务,很少将几个冷冻的LLMs加成标签,另一种是每个用户一个参数的转移,其证据来自Amazon Reviews 2023和CMU-MOSEI记录有四个读者。

blocks.en: Related work. Temperature, vector, and Dirichlet scaling calibrate class probabilities from held-out labels [ 8 , 9 ] and are the usual fix for miscalibrated LLM confidences [ 7 ] , and contextual and batch calibration [ 2 , 10 ] remove an LLM’s label bias without labels; all ignore the order of the classes. Ordinal-aware losses calibrate classifiers during training [ 11 ] , and LLM raters on ordinal scales drift toward the middle [ 5 ] and depend on the order of options and demonstrations [ 12 ] ; we correct a frozen reader after the fact. Confusion-matrix models of noisy observers go back to Dawid and Skene [ 13 ] , with ordinal crowd labels aggregated by minimax conditional entropy [ 14 ] , and human and model probabilities fused through calibrated confusion matrices [ 15 ] . Ordinal regression [ 16 ] maps features directly to the scale; supra-Bayesian pooling treats an expert’s statement as data with its own likelihood [ 17 ] , which is the view taken here for an LLM.
blocks.zh: 相关工作. 温度,矢量,和Drichlet的校准等级概率从被搁置的标签[8,9],是错误校准LLM置信度[7]的通常固定,背景和批量校准[2,10]去掉一个LLM的标签偏差而无标签;所有都忽略了这些类别的顺序. 视选择和演示的顺序而定, 在训练过程中, 噪音观测器的混沌-矩阵模型可以追溯到Dawid和Skene[13],其中的官能团标注由微型麦克斯有条件的 en[14]汇总,人类和模型概率通过校准的混沌矩阵[15] . 平面回归[16]地图直接显示在比例尺上;超巴耶斯语集合将专家的语句视为自身可能的数据[17],这是此处对LLM的看法.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en: Benchmarks. Amazon Reviews 2023 [ 20 ] provides review text, a 1–5 star rating ( K = 5 K=5 ), and a reviewer identifier; we use three product domains (Digital Music, All Beauty, Software), each with 2,000 calibration and 4,000 report reviews from single-review users plus 400 repeat users with at least eight reviews (up to 16 each, in time order). CMU-MOSEI [ 21 ] provides transcribed video segments with an averaged sentiment in [ − 3 , 3 ] [-3,3] , rounded to seven levels ( K = 7 K=7 ); its train and validation splits (18,135 segments) form the calibration pool and its test split (4,653 segments from 675 videos) the report pool.
blocks.zh: 基准。 Amazon Reviews 2023 [20]提供评论文本,1–5星级评分(K = 5 K = 5),以及评论员标识;我们使用三个产品域(Digital Music, All Beauty, Software),每个域有2000个校准和4000个单审查用户的报告评论,加上400个至少8个评论的重复用户(每个最多16个,按时间顺序). CMU-MOSEI[21]为转录的视频段提供了[− 3, 3] [3, 3] 的平均情绪,四舍五入到7级(K= 7 K= 7);其列车和验证拆分(18,135段)组成校准池和测试拆分(675段的4,653段)报告池.

blocks.en: Readers. Frozen Qwen2.5-Instruct 3B, 7B (main), and 14B [ 22 ] and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct [ 23 ] are prompted with the text and the K K options. The 7B reader’s mode is right for 75%, 66%, and 68% of Amazon reviews and 32% of MOSEI segments, and its errors are directional (Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh: 读者. Frozen Quen2.5-Instruct 3B, 7B(主), 14B [22]和Llama-31-8B-Instruct [23] 由文本和 K K K 选项推动. 7B的读者模式对75%、66%和68%的亚马逊评论和32%的MOSEI部分是正确的,其错误是方向性的(图2)。

blocks.en: Methods and protocol. All calibrators use the same n ∈ { 5 , 10 , … , 2000 } n\in\{5,10,\ldots,2000\} calibration labels (20 draws each) and are scored on the report pool by NLL and the ranked probability score (RPS), with probabilities floored at 10 − 4 10^{-4} . Baselines are temperature and vector scaling [ 8 ] , proportional-odds regression on the centered logits [ 16 ] with a cross-validated L 2 L_{2} penalty, Dirichlet calibration [ 9 ] with cross-validated off-diagonal and intercept penalties, and the three stacks of Section 2.5. Label-free batch calibration [ 10 ] does not lower the raw NLL. Paired 95% intervals use 10,000 bootstrap draws over report items and label subsets; a difference is resolved when its interval excludes zero. Fitting ours takes 7–30 s on one CPU core and predicting 0.2 ms per text.
blocks.zh: 方法和规程。 所有校准器都使用相同的n { { 5 , 10 ,..., 2000 } n\in 5 , 10 ,\ ldots, 2000 { 校准标签 (每张20 画) , 并被 NLL 和 排名概率分数 (RPS) 评分, 概率下限为 10 − 4 10 { } 。 基线为温度和矢量缩放[8],在中心对数上比例-乘积回归[16],带有交叉验证的L2 L_{2}罚,Drichlet校准[9],带有交叉验证的对角和截击罚,以及2.5节的三堆. 无标签批量校准 [10] 不降低原始NLL. Paired 95%的间隔使用 10,000 拖曳拖曳方式对报告项和标签子集进行绘图;当间隔排除0时就会解决差异。 搭配我们的 需要7 -30 s在一个CPU核心 并预测每个文本0.2 ms。

blocks.en: 3.1 Few labels: structure beats size
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 少数标签: 结构跳动大小

blocks.en: With the 7B reader, ours has the lowest NLL among nine calibrators, the eight in Table 1 and the fixed-penalty ordinal regression used inside the stack, at every budget from 5 to 100 labels on all four benchmarks (Fig. 1 ). With 20 labels it matches the logit stack with 28–54 labels and Dirichlet calibration with 79–132. Against the logit stack it gains 0.046, 0.057, 0.024, and 0.053 nats at n = 20 n=20 for Music, Beauty, Software, and MOSEI and 0.002–0.016 at n = 100 n=100 , with every gain resolved except on Software beyond 20 labels; the same stack with full or scalar channels changes the logit stack’s NLL at n = 20 n=20 by − 0.015 -0.015 to + 0.014 +0.014 and trails ours by resolved margins of 0.031–0.067, so the gain comes from the structure rather than from more members. Posterior averaging adds up to 0.134 nats over the posterior mode with ten labels or fewer and nothing from 100 on. The RPS agrees, favoring ours over the logit stack by 0.008–0.017 at n = 20 n=20 , and accuracy matches the logit stack. Grouped by the reader’s stated class (Fig. 2 ), ours is closest to the labels on all four benchmarks at n = 20 n=20 : its class-weighted KL is 0.06–0.17, against 0.10–0.22 for the logit stack, 0.31–0.55 for Dirichlet calibration, and 0.32–1.97 for the raw reader. The labels are ordered in y y on every benchmark, and so, by Proposition 1, are the temperature-reading channels; fitted on 20 labels, vector scaling and Dirichlet calibration map saturated readings of some adjacent classes to predictions reversed by more than 0.05 in cumulative probability in 45–80% and 45–70% of fits, and ours in at most 10%.

blocks.en: Reader size and family. With the 3B, 14B, and Llama readers, CORDIAL is best in 56 of 60 settings with 5 to 100 labels, trails by at most 0.006 in the other four, and leads the logit stack at n = 20 n=20 by resolved margins of 0.012–0.086.

blocks.en: In-context examples. Used as in-context demonstrations for the 7B reader, the same 20 to 100 labels give accuracy within − 0.06 -0.06 to + 0.02 +0.02 of ours but a 2.3 to 3.3 times higher NLL.
blocks.zh: 内容中的例子。 同样的20至100个标签用作7B阅读器的内文演示,在−0.06-0.06至+0.02+0.02之间给出了准确度,但NLL值高出2.3至3.3倍。

blocks.en: 3.2 What the posterior buys
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 后人买的

blocks.en: A learned prior. With the prior learned from the other datasets, ours gains on average 0.017, 0.016, 0.011, 0.006, and 0.003 nats with 5, 10, 20, 50, and 100 labels over the twelve Amazon reader–domain pairs; the gain is resolved for 9 or 10 pairs at each budget, and no pair shows a resolved loss. On MOSEI, with a prior from Amazon alone, it costs 0.009–0.011 at n ≤ 10 n\leq 10 and gains 0.013–0.015 at 20–50.
blocks.zh: 之前学过的 随着先前从其他数据集中汲取的教训,我们的平均收益为0.017、0.016、0.011、0.006和0.003纳特,在12对亚马逊读者的域对上标有5、10、20、50和100个标签;每个预算的9或10对收益都解决了,没有一对显示已解决的损失。 在MOSEI上,仅亚马逊的一个前身,在n 10 n\leq 10时花费0.009-0.011美元,在20-50时收获0.013-0.015美元。

blocks.en: Several readers. The four-reader fusion, designed on validation texts, beats the 7B reader alone in all 28 settings from 5 to 500 labels, by 0.008–0.090 nats, the reader chosen by cross-validation in all 28, and the same fusion without channels in 27, by 0.011–0.043 at n = 20 n=20 ; Dirichlet calibration of the concatenated readings trails by 0.55–1.5 nats there. On MOSEI with 10–20 labels Llama alone is 0.018–0.030 better; the multi-reader channel adds at most 0.006.
blocks.zh: 几个读者. 根据验证文本设计的四读聚变,将所有28个场合的7B读取器单打5至500个标签,0.008–0.090纳特,所有28个版本的交叉验证选择的读取器,27个版本的没有信道的相同聚变器,以0.011–0.043在n=20比0. n=20; Drichlet 校准了那里0.55–1.5纳特的调制读数小径. 在MOSEI上,仅Llama的10–20标签就更好了0.018–0.030;多读频道最多增加0.06.

blocks.en: Across users. A per-user shift channel on the population fit (1,000 labels) gains, after eleven or more earlier texts of the user, 0.100, 0.046, 0.044, and 0.048 nats on Music, Beauty, Software, and MOSEI, all resolved. Over all texts it beats a per-user reliability by 0.013–0.041, a per-user temperature by 0.004–0.016, and a random-intercept ordinal regression by 0.021–0.029 on Amazon, tying it on MOSEI.
blocks.zh: 横跨用户. 在用户较早的十一个或更多文本、音乐、美容、软件和MOSEI上, 在所有文本中,它比每个用户的可靠性高出0.013-0.41,比每个用户的温度高出0.004-0.016,比亚马逊0.021-0.029的随机干扰率回归,将其绑在MOSEI上。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: An LLM’s ordinal output can be viewed as a noisy sensor with systematic offset, gain, and concentration errors. Our five-parameter Bayesian channel calibrates these distortions from few labels and naturally extends to learned priors, multiple readers, and user-specific adaptation.
blocks.zh: LLM 的正线输出可被视为有系统抵消、增益和浓度错误的噪音传感器。 我们的五参数的巴耶斯频道校准这些扭曲, 由很少的标签, 自然延伸至学习过的前科, 多个阅读器, 和用户特有的适应。

blocks.en: 5 Compliance with Ethical Standards
blocks.zh: 5 遵守道德标准

blocks.en: This study reuses two public datasets, Amazon Reviews 2023 and CMU-MOSEI transcripts, with the user and speaker identifiers they provide. It involves no new participant recruitment or intervention.
blocks.zh: 这项研究重新使用了两个公共数据集,即Amazon Reviews 2023和CMU-MOSEI记录誊本,并附有他们提供的用户和扬声器标识符. 它不涉及新参与者的征聘或干预。
